description: CuSTaRD baseline knowledge base, migrated from the 2023 MSc prototype (University of Manchester). Checklists derived from vendor hardening guidance; vulnerabilities and mitigations from NIST SP 800-30, MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, CVE and ISO/IEC 27001 as described in the dissertation.

vulnerabilities.name: Unpatched Software
mitigations: Regularly update and patch all software

vulnerabilities.name: Weak or No Password Protection
mitigations: Implement strong password policies and enforce multi-factor authentication

vulnerabilities.name: Outdated Antivirus/Antimalware
mitigations: Ensure antivirus and antimalware software are up-to-date

checklist.text: Use Secure Protocols for Data Transfer
Stay Updated with Latest Security Best Practices
Backup Data in Secure Offsite Locations
Secure Physical Access to Financial Data
Limit Access to HR and Management
Store in Secure Digital and Physical Environments
Restrict and Monitor Transportation of Tapes
Regularly Patch and Update Database Software
Prevent SQL Injection and Other Attacks
Ensure Proper Disposal of Outdated Material
Implement Digital Rights Management if Necessary
Analyze Data in Aggregated and Anonymized Form
Secure Storage for Physical Marketing Data
Regularly Review and Update Marketing Data
